grammar_focus: 冠词 the/a/some/any + 专有名词(主考:肯定句用 some、否定疑问用 any · 河流/海洋/山脉/含普通名词的国名前用 the:the Wayle/the Thames/the Pacific/the Alps/the United States · 人名/城市/单个国名不加冠词)+ so…that 结果状语从句 / 方向介词 toward / that 定语从句(辅考·课文①类)
scene: 威尔河横穿'我'家附近的公园。上星期天天气暖和,'我'像往常一样坐在河岸边;有孩子在岸上玩,有人在河上划船。突然一个孩子狠狠踢出一球,球朝一只驶过的小船飞去,重重打在船上那人身上,他差点掉进水里。'我'回头找孩子,却一个也不见——全跑光了!那人明白过来后大笑,冲孩子们喊话,把球扔回岸上。

grammar_card.title: 冠词 the / a / some / any + 专名
grammar_card.intro: 本课学冠词:肯定句用 some,否定和疑问用 any;河流、海洋、山脉、含普通名词的国名前用 the(the Wayle / the Pacific / the Alps / the United States);人名、城市、单个国名前不用冠词。全用本课和 Key structures 的句子举例。

rows: There weren't any children in sight.
河流 / 海洋 / 山脉前 → the
the Wayle / the Pacific / the Alps
含普通名词的国名 → the
the United States / the People's Republic of China
人名 / 城市 / 单个国名 → 不加冠词
John lives in England. Paris, Rome

specialRules.rule: so + 形容词 + that:表示'如此…以至于…',前面接形容词或副词(struck him so hard that he nearly fell)
方向介词 toward(美语常不带 s):the ball went toward the boat;that 引导定语从句指物:a river that cuts across the park

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — What happened to the man in the boat?
options: The ball struck him and he nearly fell into the water
He fell asleep in the boat
He rowed away before the ball came

passage: The Wayle is a small river that cuts across the park near my home. I like sitting by the Wayle on fine afternoons. It was warm last Sunday, so I went and sat on the riverbank as usual. Some children were playing games on the bank, and there were some people rowing on the river. Suddenly, one of the children kicked a ball very hard, and it went toward a passing boat. Some people on the bank called out to the man in the boat, but he did not hear them. The ball struck him so hard that he nearly fell into the water. I turned to look at the children, but there weren't any in sight — they had all run away! The man laughed when he realized what had happened. He called out to the children and threw the ball back to the bank.

grammar_points.name: some / any:肯定句用 some,否定疑问用 any
the + 河流 / 海洋专名(the Wayle / the Pacific)
the + 山脉 / 含普通名词的国名(the Alps / the United States)
a / an:初次提及、单数泛指(辅音前 a、元音前 an)
so + 形容词 + that 结果状语从句(辅考)
方向介词 toward / to(辅考)
that 引导定语从句(指物,辅考)

stage5.stem: "The river was ___ wide that we could not swim across."(那么…以至于,填结果连词)

stage5.stem: "The ball went ___ a passing boat."(表示"朝、向"的方向)
